title: Benchmark telemetry harness
description: Objective: emit the machine-readable run, cost-class, timing, effort, settings, evidence-receipt, and reproducibility records required by the pinned benchmark. Deliverable: benchmark harness infrastructure without confirmatory corpus bytes. NOT in scope: competitor scoring or claim decisions. Hard dependencies: stable daemon/provider/control-room instrumentation. Owned paths: packages/benchmark/** excluding confirmatory corpus and campaign outputs. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/benchmark test.
definitionOfDone: Every required measurement has exact source/basis or explicit UNKNOWN; UNKNOWN is never zero or imputed across arms.
Run records bind model/profile/runtime/settings/source/evidence identities and all timing split points.
Harness self-tests cover censoring, cost bases, fixtures, concurrency, and receipt tamper.
taskRails: Claims follow the benchmark permit-list; missing, partial, cross-basis, or unverifiable evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS.
No confirmatory corpus is generated or viewed until the implementation commit is frozen exactly as specified.
GO_QUIESCE and GO_ACTIVATE are separate human decisions. Keep evidence exact, reproducible, and scoped to one source commit.
reopenReason: Governor routing 01:48Z under the human's standing unblock directive. Premise re-verified this session: launchClaudeWithTelemetry / parseClaudeResultTelemetry / normalizeUsageMeasurement still have ZERO non-test callers in apps/ (ClaudeTelemetryHandoff has one), and packages/benchmark is absent — the Clause-2 conclusion (harness would be fixture-fed) still holds AS A WORKER conclusion. The ARCHITECT output it calls for: measure the emission gap symbol by symbol and file the prerequisite production tasks that make apps/ actually EMIT the telemetry (@moe/runner and @moe/scheduler already publish all four surfaces; the 1a7ff ledger just landed as the durable sink — the missing link is production call sites), then re-block this harness on those ids. Note the standing hazard recorded in the old reason: this task's own verification `pnpm --filter @moe/benchmark test` exits 0 vacuously while the package is absent — any new DoD must require a nonzero executed-test count.

That last one's package name is not a directory anywhere, so no directory heuristic can be patched into correctness.
Correct test is name-in-workspace.

Their positive control - `pnpm --filter @moe/contracts test` printing "Test Files 12 passed (12) / Tests 416 passed (416)" - versus the vacuous arm printing no count line at all, makes the presence of a `Test Files N passed` line the actual test. The rail now names that line.

NOTHING ABOUT THIS TASK'S BLOCK CHANGES. It stands on its own measurement: launchClaudeWithTelemetry, parseClaudeResultTelemetry, ClaudeTelemetryHandoff and normalizeUsageMeasurement all have zero non-test callers under apps/; unblock is the five owners DONE AND all four greps returning >0 apps/ hits. Its block was environmental, not defective: code complete and committed in 9d60091, steps 1-6 done, and step 7's gate was being reddened by peers mid-refactor.
